run_receptacles_data_collection: run the CLI to aggregate receptacle positions, generate images, and create templated Q/A datasets for all scenes
run_receptacle_position_aggregate: run the script to aggregate receptacle positions by scene across all episodes and save to pickle
run_gen_receptacle_images: run the script to generate RGB images of receptacles from view points and save to HDF5
run_gen_dataset_question: run the script to generate templated multiple choice Q/A pairs per episode and save to HDF5
run_extract_scene_id: run the script to extract a scene ID from a full scene file path string
